controls: RHS Lighting: Voxel reflections, Reflection steps; Cones and indirect light expands GI controls; Lens bloom and sliders are in the same menu

contract.requirements: Ready paired static opacity/radiance hierarchy, Cones, and GI enabled. Scenes with live rigid bodies retain the complete legacy sky closure.
contract.aperture: 2 atan(roughness squared), full angle in radians
contract.energy: (gathered radiance + transmittance * prefiltered sky) * existing environment BRDF, once
contract.invalidSource: Legacy sky BRDF and legacy occlusion retained; invalid counter and derived-page failure flag set.
contract.exhaustion: Finite partial radiance with remaining sky; separate diagnostic count.
contract.diagnostics: copyVoxelSpecularDiagnostics: four uint32 words: traces, exhausted, invalid source, rigid-body fallback. Reset per encoded frame; reused dry frames do not trace again.
contract.movingBodies: Feature globally falls back whenever actual uniform body count is positive; no center-ray approximation to full rough-cone body coverage.

validation.finalGpu: Exclusive tools/gpu/fluid-gpu-run.sh timing fixture passed 2/2: actual production closure is bit-identical to legacy expression when disabled, when rigid bodies require fallback, and when radiance is invalid; separate trace/invalid/fallback counters verified. Known emissive voxel, empty sky, bounded exhaustion, and missing pages passed. Full-rate and reduced production WGSL validated.

actualScene.note: Fresh frozen dry-frame production draw; all5 GPU execution sentinels passed. Counts establish this scene/budget has no exhausted or invalid gathers, not Cycles equivalence.

storageBindingRegression.problem: Specular diagnostics were unnecessarily visible to compute and could exceed the granted 10-storage-buffer limit.
storageBindingRegression.fix: Binding 29 is fragment-only; shading and diagnostic writes are unchanged.
storageBindingRegression.result: 24 production mesh compute pipelines compiled across full and half scales on a device explicitly granted maxStorageBuffersPerShaderStage=10; both regression tests passed.

limitations: Radiance grid and tetrahedral directional reconstruction limit mirror detail.
Cone approximation is not a full GGX path integral.
Finite budget can exhaust before scene exit; diagnostics expose this.
Static radiance atlas does not publish moving-body radiance; whole-scene fallback preserves previous behavior in those scenes.
